title: AuditEvidence
description: Signed audit evidence blob used by /z-followup-confirm --via=audit. schema_version must be 1, review_verdict must be literal PASS, test_exit_code must be 0.

entry_id.description: ID of the followup entry this evidence is for

review_verdict_path.description: Path to the verdict.md artifact from /z-review-all

review_verdict.description: Must be the literal string PASS

diff_artifact_path.description: Path to the cumulative.diff artifact from the run

capture_head.description: git commit SHA at follow-up entry creation time

verify_head.description: git commit SHA at verification time; must be a descendant of capture_head

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when verification was performed

verified_by_run.description: Run ID that produced this audit evidence
